Salem Custom Screen Printing is a small, faith-driven business creating custom apparel for individuals, churches, events, and youth camps — and this website doubles as my personal development project. I'm continuously building out new features, refining the look and feel, and expanding functionality, so it can serve as a live, evolving showcase of my skills for anyone who wants to see what I know and what I'm learning next.
